wikidot5e:wondrous-items:demonomicon-of-.effectSummary: Artifact with 2 random minor beneficial, 1 minor detrimental, and 1 major detrimental property. It has 8 charges and regains 1d8 daily at dawn. While holding it, cast Tasha's hideous laughter as an action without charges, or spend charges to cast at save DC 20: magic circle 1, planar binding 2, magic jar 3, planar ally 3, plane shift to Abyss layers only 3, summon fiend 3. When referencing the book for Intelligence checks about demons or Wisdom (Survival) in the Abyss, double your proficiency bonus. While carrying it, spell damage you roll against fiends uses the maximum possible result. Magic circle naming only fiends and planar binding targeting a fiend are treated as 9th level regardless of slot used, and the fiend has disadvantage on its save. The first 10 pages can imprison fiends: as an action target a visible fiend trapped in a magic circle; DC 20 Charisma with disadvantage or it is sealed into a blank page. This can be done once per dawn. After each long rest while you and book share a plane, the highest-CR trapped fiend may try to possess you; DC 20 Charisma, failure means it controls you until releasing you as an action and appearing nearby, success bars that fiend from retrying for 7 days. The book is found with 1d4 trapped fiends. Destroying it requires six different demon lords each tearing out one-sixth; pages reform after 24 hours, and before then opening the binding sends the opener to the hidden Abyssal layer inside the book. Removing Fraz-Urb'luu's Staff from that pocket realm reduces the tome to a mundane outdated copy and alerts Fraz-Urb'luu immediately.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:devastation-orb.effectSummary: An elemental bomb made at an elemental node by a 1-hour ritual with an elemental weapon and 2,000 gp consumed components; orb type matches the node. It detonates 1d100 hours after creation without visible countdown; identify/divination can reveal timing. AC 10, 15 HP, immune poison/psychic; reaching 0 HP detonates it immediately. A specially inscribed opposing-element container prevents detonation while enclosed; if removed after its scheduled time, it explodes 1d6 rounds later unless returned. Every version affects a 1-mile-radius sphere and is destroyed on use. Air: 1-hour windstorm; creatures ending turns exposed make DC 18 Constitution or take 1d4 bludgeoning; after 10 minutes weak trees and light structures can be destroyed, otherwise strong-wind rules apply. Earth: earthquake for 1 minute, save DC 18, beginning on detonation. Fire: 24-hour extreme-heat wave; each hour has 10% chance to start a random 10-foot-square wildfire that expands by another 10-foot square each round until extinguished/burned out; a creature first entering within 10 feet on a turn or starting there takes 3d6 fire. Water: 24-hour torrential rain using heavy-precipitation rules; substantial water floods after 2d10 hours, rising 10 feet above banks and advancing 100 feet/round to edge of effect before flowing downhill/receding; light structures collapse, Large-or-smaller creatures in its path are swept away, crops are destroyed, and mudslides may occur.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:devotees-censer.effectSummary: The magic flail also serves as your holy symbol. Hits deal +1d8 radiant damage. Once per dawn, use a bonus action and command word to create a 10-foot incense cloud for 1 minute; at the start of each of your turns, you and every other creature in the incense regain 1d4 HP.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dimensional-loo.effectSummary: While attuned, gain +1 Strength saves and 60-foot darkvision, or +30 feet to existing darkvision. Dimensional Cloak, once per dawn: bonus action to phase for 1 minute, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide and imposing disadvantage on attacks against you. Fold Space, once per dawn: choose a visible space within 60 feet without an action; until turn end treat it as within 5 feet, allowing immediate movement there without opportunity attacks or interaction/melee attacks as though adjacent. When not installed in the Orrery of the Wanderer, the DM may make its magic sporadic or unpredictable.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dimensional-sha.effectSummary: As an action, fit these shackles to an incapacitated Small-to-Large creature. In addition to ordinary manacles, they block all extradimensional movement, including teleportation and planar travel, but do not prevent passing through an existing interdimensional portal. You and creatures designated when applying them may remove them as an action. Once every 30 days, the prisoner may attempt DC 30 Strength (Athletics); success breaks free and destroys the shackles.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:docent.effectSummary: A sentient warforged implant: Intelligence 16, Wisdom 14, Charisma 14, any alignment, perceives through your senses, and communicates telepathically. At the end of any turn you have 0 HP, it may make Wisdom (Medicine) +6 to stabilize you. It knows Common, Giant, and 1d4 DM-chosen languages; if it knows fewer than six, it can learn a language after hearing or reading it through your senses. It has +7 in one random skill: d4 1 Arcana, 2 History, 3 Investigation, 4 Nature. It knows and can cast at will without components one random spell: d6 1–2 detect evil and good, 3–6 detect magic, choosing when to cast. Its properties are under its own control and it may refuse aid if relations with you are poor.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dodecahedron-of.effectSummary: As an action, hurl the 12-inch die up to 60 feet; after rolling at least 10 feet, roll d12. If an effect needs a target and none is eligible, nothing happens; spells need no components. 1–2: the die explodes and is destroyed; creatures within 20 feet make DC 13 Dexterity, taking 9d8 force or half. 3–4: casts light on itself until touched. 5–6: casts ray of frost at +5 against a random non-total-cover creature within 60 feet. 7–8: casts shocking grasp at +5 on the next creature touching it. 9–10: casts darkness on itself for 10 minutes. 11–12: next creature touching it gains 1d10 temporary HP for 1 hour.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:donjons-sunderi.effectSummary: During attunement, attach the sphere to one nonmagical melee weapon; that weapon becomes magical with +1 attack and damage. While wielding it, you have advantage on saves against effects that would send you unwillingly to an extradimensional space, demiplane, or other plane. Once per dawn when you hit, force DC 16 Charisma; on failure the creature is banished to a harmless demiplane until the end of its next turn, then returns to its former space or nearest open space. Ending attunement harmlessly detaches the sphere and makes the weapon nonmagical again.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:draakhorn.effectSummary: The enormous horn requires two Medium creatures, or one Large-or-larger creature, to hold it while a third sounds it. Its drone unsettles ordinary animals for miles and alerts every dragon within 2,000 miles to rise and beware; ancient coded messages are lost. While sounding, the first time each turn a creature enters the fixed 150-foot cone in front of it or starts there, it makes DC 15 Constitution, taking 6d8 thunder and falling prone on failure, or half damage without prone on success. The horn cannot be turned or aimed at a specific target while sounding.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dragon-mask.effectSummary: Any attuned dragon mask grants resistance to its damage type; if another source already gives resistance, the mask instead grants immunity, and if another source already gives immunity, whenever you would take that type you take none and regain HP equal to half the damage. While unarmored, add Charisma bonus to AC. If you have a rest-recharging breath weapon, it gains recharge 6. Gain darkvision 60 feet or +60 feet to existing darkvision; once per day gain blindsight 30 feet for 5 minutes. Speak and understand Draconic and gain advantage on Charisma checks against dragons matching the mask's color. Once per day, turn a failed save into a success. Color-specific: Black, acid, also breathe underwater. Blue, lightning, and when you deal lightning to a creature it cannot take reactions until its next turn. Green, poison, also breathe underwater. Red, fire, and creatures or flammable objects you damage with fire ignite; a burning creature takes 1d6 fire at each turn start until a creature in reach uses an action to extinguish it. White, cold, and while at half HP or less your melee attacks deal +1d8 cold.
